_about: Reference cases for the photo-edit-advisor skill.
Photos are named by catalogue id and filename, never bundled: the RAW files live
on the photographer's disk and the JPEGs are re-exported per run. That keeps
the suite in version control without a binary fixture set, and it means the
expectations below describe the PHOTOS, not a particular export.
Every expectation here was measured against Lightroom Classic 15.4 during the
session that built this skill, and the dust positions were cross-checked
against Lightroom's own Dust Removal regions. Where a number is a judgement
rather than a measurement it is written as a band, not a point.
The catalogue is live, so expectations are re-measured when the photos drift:
two Salta frames were re-edited after that first session (Highlights/Shadows
changed) and their detections moved with them. Each such case records the
re-measurement date and the reason, so the numbers stay a description of the
photos rather than of one export.

export.note: export_photos creates the destination folder when it is missing

cases.what_it_checks: the dust pipeline finds known sensor dirt and nothing else
requires: These photos must have NO Dust Removal applied: check FilterList is [] via
get_develop_settings with fields 'all' and max_depth 16. They were edited
during the session that produced these numbers, so reproducing this case
means resetting them first -- which also discards the removal.
This case and 'removal-verified' are opposite states of the same photo and
cannot both be exported from the catalogue at once.
As of 2026-09-23 the removal CANNOT be discarded from the SDK: clear_spots
touches only the classic RetouchInfo store, reset_develop scope=tools
spot_removal/healing calls resetSpotRemoval/resetHealing and leaves the AI
patches in place, set_develop_settings rejects EnableDistractionRemoval as
unknown, create_virtual_copies fails because this SDK has no
photo:createVirtualCopy, and reset_develop scope=all would also wipe the
user's masks (personas, radial gradients) that the tool cannot restore.
Discarding the removal is a manual step in the Lightroom UI. Until it is
done this case stays blocked and 'arocena-clean-frame-dust' covers the
detection half of what it checks.

expect._why_warning: two lenses: the distortion profiles differ, so positions are not comparable

cases.what_it_checks: the detector finds the session's real sensor dirt in a clean, un-removed frame
requires: The counterpart to 'arocena-dust-present': that case needs three frames
with Dust Removal discarded, which cannot be done from the SDK. This one
uses a clean frame that still shows the dirt, so it exports from the
catalogue as it stands.

expect._why: two of the three known specks land inside this frame's smooth sky and are
expect._why2: detected at the expected sensor positions: (0.575, 0.127) and (0.290, 0.103),
expect._why3: measured against the positions 'arocena-dust-present' cross-checked against
expect._why4: Lightroom's own Dust Removal regions. The third speck is not observable here:
expect._why5: this frame's sky has no smooth bright patch at that position.
expect._frame: spot_near targets are EXPORT coordinates, not sensor coordinates

cases.what_it_checks: genuinely independent viewpoints with nothing to find return nothing

expect._why: cloudy skies full of structure: dust is not observable, which is not the same as absent
expect._remeasured: 2026-09-23 -- persistent_count 0 no longer holds. The frames were re-edited
expect._why_remeasure: DSC09299 and DSC09460 now produce one recurrence at (0.136, 0.243) scoring 15.2.
expect._why_remeasure2: The background check scores it 0.56 and flags it for review, which is the defence
expect._why_remeasure3: the design actually offers, so the case asserts that defence instead: nothing is
expect._why_remeasure4: reported as dust without a warning attached.

cases.what_it_checks: one viewpoint mislabelled as two scenes gets flagged for review

expect._why: the two tags are one viewpoint; the skyline and cloud band repeat and score 0.67-0.80
expect._why_max: without the Hessian edge test this returns 5, the fifth being the sun
expect._remeasured: 2026-09-23 -- min_warned 3 -> 2. The third recurrence now scores -0.14
expect._why_remeasure: between the frames (early vs golden), so the background check stays silent on it.
expect._why_remeasure2: The two flagged ones still score 0.66 and 0.69, inside the documented band.

cases.what_it_checks: cloud edges and skylines are dropped before anything is correlated
requires: This case exists because the eval suite once passed with the edge test
disabled. A frame of banded cloud produces thousands of ridge responses,
and a Laplacian answers to them as loudly as to a blob.

expect._why: with the edge test: 4 spots and ~7000 rejections. Without it: 14 spots.

cases.what_it_checks: shadow headroom orders by how noisy the shadows actually are
after Lightroom's Dust Removal the spots are gone from a re-export
requires: Distraction Removal (Dust) must be APPLIED in the Lightroom UI -- there is
no SDK call for it. Export that state under the name below so it does not
collide with the clean export used by 'arocena-dust-present'.
